Q5217.reason: Costco's confirmation was expressly conditional on a loading charge, so it is a counteroffer under UCC 2-207 and the writings alone form no contract, though conduct under 2-207(3) could still create one.

Q6156.reason: Former testimony requires the party against whom it is offered to have had a similar motive to cross-examine on the same issue, and the company's deposition in the wrongful-termination suit did not address the structural-defect issue.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani v. UK (2001) the Court held that applying state immunity did not violate Article 6's right of access to a court, so immunities were not in conflict with the right to a fair trial.
